name: file-explorer
description: File tree pane that follows Claude's reads, edits and searches, with git status, search, preview and path references

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts; the terminal seats it from 144 columns, else /file-explorer opens it.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: Expand the tree to each file Claude reads, edits or creates and move the cursor there.

animations.title: Flash touched files
animations.description: Shimmer a file's name for a moment when Claude touches it, and while Claude writes it; off keeps only the coloured mark.

showHidden.title: Show hidden files
showHidden.description: Start with dotfiles shown ("." in the pane toggles them).

mtime.title: Modified column
mtime.description: Show how long ago each file was modified (3m, 2h, yesterday) at the right of its row.

ignore.title: Ignored names
ignore.description: Comma-separated folder or file names drawn dimmed and left out of search and the search walk.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Order inside a folder, folders first: by name, by extension, or newest first.

enterAction.title: Enter on a file
enterAction.description: What Enter or a double click does on a file: preview it in the pane, or open it in the editor.

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: Command that opens a file, run without a shell: {path}, {dir} and {line} are filled in (code -g {path}:{line}). Empty opens the default app.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Nerd Font glyphs in the terminal (needs a patched font) or plain Unicode. Other surfaces always use Unicode.

theme.title: Colours
theme.description: auto follows the Claude Code theme; dark and light are fixed palettes.

git.title: Git indicators
git.description: full: status letters and lines added and removed; status: letters only; off: no git.

search.title: Search
search.description: fuzzy matches the letters in order; substring needs them together.

refreshSeconds.title: Background check (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: While the pane is open, how often shown folders are checked for changes made outside Claude; 0 turns it off.
